PRIMARY CONTROL: x-cap.synqs.run_experiment.v1 takes operations (Load, RLX, RLZ, RLZ2 with one parameter each), shots and observable (ZObs, LZ, LZ2); it calls native.pre_apply(), native.apply() per operation, native.sample() to post, polls native.check_job_status() with self.check_cancelled(), then native.sample() to fetch. Reads: qdim, shots, job_id, job_status and endpoint. The action is long_running and cancellable. Both numeric inputs are Limit.operator_required because the clone states no single range for the operation parameter (an angle for RLX/RLZ/RLZ2, a qudit-dimension offset for Load) and the constructor shots=1 is a library default, not a device bound; site-limits.example.json is example data only.

STOP: the only HTTP routes in the clone are post_job/ (pennylane_ls/single_qudit_device.py:121), get_job_status/ (pennylane_ls/django_device.py:47) and get_job_result/ (pennylane_ls/single_qudit_device.py:144). reset() clears the local qdim, job_id and job_payload only (single_qudit_device.py:163-166); wait_till_done sleeps and polls until DONE with no cancellation (django_device.py:62-70). No stop, cancel or abort word or endpoint occurs in the clone. A posted experiment therefore runs to completion on the control server; the MHS latch would stop later submissions only, not the running job. The README points real hardware to labscript-qc (README.md:37) and describes optical-tweezer cold-atom experiments (README.md:10,12); the package declares R2 (no laser class is stated, so R3 is not claimed). No independent hardware e-stop is documented, so estop_physical_ref is unset and no safe-state action is declared; a reset or a local job_id clear would be a false stop, so none is used. Unblocking needs a source-backed stop or cancel route (or a cited physical e-stop) from the labscript-qc deployment.

FAKE: an in-memory source-shaped stand-in, not a recording and not an upstream simulator. It mirrors pre_apply/apply/sample/check_job_status/wait_till_done/reset, stores placeholder samples and a placeholder job id, and models no qudit physics, Django queue, HTTP transport or labscript-qc timing. Its numbers are placeholders.
